part2.audioText: What's the agenda for this afternoon's meeting?
optionAudioTexts: Mainly the budget for next year.
part2.explanation: What 問會議議程內容，(A)「主要是明年度預算」正確。(B) 回答地點，(C) 疑問詞問句不能用 Yes 回答。

part2.audioText: Where does the airport shuttle pick up passengers?
part2.explanation: Where 問地點，(B)「就在飯店大廳外」正確。(A) 頻率、(C) 價格皆答非所問。

part2.audioText: Didn't Maria already send out the press release?
part2.explanation: 否定疑問句確認新聞稿是否已發出，(A)「是的，昨天發出去了」正確。(B) 用 press 的字面義混淆。

part2.audioText: Who's responsible for updating the company website?
optionAudioTexts: The IT team handles that now.
part2.explanation: Who 問人，(C)「現在由 IT 團隊負責」正確。(A) 名詞、(B) 時間皆未回答「誰」。

part2.audioText: Why don't you take a break? You've been working all morning.
optionAudioTexts: Good idea. I could use some coffee.
part2.explanation: Why don't you...? 是建議（休息一下吧），(A)「好主意，我正想喝杯咖啡」正確。(B) 用 brake/break 諧音混淆。

part2.audioText: Is the annual report ready, or do you need more time?
optionAudioTexts: I need until tomorrow morning, I'm afraid.
part2.explanation: 選擇疑問句（好了還是需要更多時間），(B)「恐怕要到明天早上」選擇後者，正確。

part2.audioText: How do I request reimbursement for my travel expenses?
optionAudioTexts: Fill out the form on the intranet.
part2.explanation: How 問申請方式，(A)「在內部網站填表」正確。(C) 回答交通方式，非申請方式。

part2.audioText: We should leave for the station soon, shouldn't we?
optionAudioTexts: Yes, the train leaves in forty minutes.
part2.explanation: 附加問句確認該出發了，(A)「對，火車四十分鐘後開」正確。(C) 用 station/stationery 諧音混淆。

script: W: Ben, I'm setting up the interview schedule for the graphic designer position. Are you free to join the panel next Monday?
M: Monday's difficult. I'm presenting at the client workshop all day. Could we do Tuesday instead?
W: Tuesday works. We have four candidates, so it'll take most of the morning, from nine to about twelve thirty.
M: That's fine. Will we see their portfolios before the interviews?
W: Yes, I'll share a folder with everyone's portfolio and résumé by Friday, so we can review them over the weekend.
M: Great. One more thing — the design team asked if candidates could complete a short design task. Should we send it in advance?
W: Good idea. I'll e-mail the task to the candidates today so they can present their work during the interview.

questions.q: What position are the speakers hiring for?
questions.explanation: 女子說 I'm setting up the interview schedule for the graphic designer position，招募平面設計師，故選 (A)。

questions.q: Why can't the man attend on Monday?
options: He is presenting at a workshop.
questions.explanation: 男子說 I'm presenting at the client workshop all day（整天要在客戶工作坊簡報），故選 (B)。

questions.q: What will the woman do today?
options: Send a design task to candidates
questions.explanation: 女子說 I'll e-mail the task to the candidates today（今天把設計題目寄給應徵者），故選 (B)。作品集是週五前分享。

script: M: Hi, I have a reservation for tonight under the name Kowalski, but I'd like to ask about changing it.
W: Of course. I see it here — a table for two at seven o'clock. What would you like to change?
M: Two of our colleagues are joining us unexpectedly, so we'll need a table for four. And could we move it to eight?
W: Let me see. At eight we only have tables on the outdoor terrace. The indoor dining room is fully booked.
M: The terrace is fine, as long as the heaters are on. It gets chilly at night.
W: They will be, sir. So that's a terrace table for four at eight o'clock. We'll see you tonight.

questions.q: Where does the conversation most likely take place?
questions.explanation: 訂位、table for two、dining room、terrace 等線索顯示是餐廳訂位對話，故選 (B)。

questions.q: Why does the man want to change his reservation?
questions.explanation: 男子說兩位同事臨時加入，需要四人桌並改到八點，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What does the man ask about the terrace?
options: Whether the heaters will be on
questions.explanation: 男子說 as long as the heaters are on（只要有開暖爐就好），故選 (A)。

part4.script: Attention all passengers on the Northline commuter train. Due to a signal problem near Central Station, all trains on the Northline are currently delayed by twenty to thirty minutes. Engineers are on site, and normal service is expected to resume by six o'clock this evening. If you are traveling to the airport, we recommend transferring to the Express Line at Riverside Station, which is operating on schedule. Passengers holding monthly passes may also use city buses at no additional charge today; simply show your pass to the driver. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

questions.explanation: Due to a signal problem near Central Station，中央車站附近號誌故障造成誤點，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What does the speaker recommend for passengers going to the airport?
questions.explanation: we recommend transferring to the Express Line at Riverside Station，建議在 Riverside 站轉乘快線，故選 (C)。

questions.q: What can monthly pass holders do today?
questions.explanation: monthly passes may also use city buses at no additional charge today，月票族今天可免費搭公車，故選 (A)。

part4.script: Good evening, and welcome to the grand reopening of the Palmer Theater. My name is Diane Foster, and as the theater's managing director, I couldn't be prouder tonight. After fourteen months of restoration, our ninety-year-old building has a new stage, modern lighting and sound systems, and — as many of you noticed on the way in — the original lobby ceiling has been beautifully restored to its 1930s design. This project would not have been possible without the generosity of over six hundred community donors. Tonight's performance by the City Symphony Orchestra begins in twenty minutes. Before that, please enjoy the reception in the lobby, where you can also pick up a season brochure. Subscriptions purchased tonight come with a fifteen percent discount. Thank you, and enjoy the show.

questions.explanation: welcome to the grand reopening of the Palmer Theater，劇院整修後重新開幕，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the lobby ceiling?
options: It was restored to its original design.
It will be painted next year.
questions.explanation: the original lobby ceiling has been beautifully restored to its 1930s design，天花板依 1930 年代原貌修復，故選 (A)。

questions.q: How can listeners get a discount tonight?
options: By joining the orchestra's fan club
questions.explanation: Subscriptions purchased tonight come with a fifteen percent discount，當晚訂閱季票享 85 折，故選 (B)。

part5.q: All visitors must sign in at the reception desk ------- arrival.
part5.explanation: upon arrival = 一抵達時，固定用法。「訪客抵達時須在櫃檯簽到」。

part5.q: The proposal was rejected because it did not meet the committee's ------- requirements.
part5.explanation: funding requirements = 經費要求（funding 作名詞修飾語）。「提案因不符合經費規定而被否決」。

part5.q: Ms. Okoye speaks French -------, having lived in Lyon for over a decade.
part5.explanation: 修飾動詞 speaks 用副詞 fluently（流利地）。「她在里昂住過十多年，法語說得很流利」。

part5.q: ------- the two candidates, Mr. Reyes has more experience in international trade.
part5.explanation: Of the two... = 兩者之中。「兩位候選人中，Reyes 先生的國際貿易經驗較豐富」。

part5.q: Construction noise may occur ------- the hours of 9 A.M. and 5 P.M. on weekdays.
part5.explanation: between A and B = 在 A 與 B 之間。「平日上午九點至下午五點間可能有施工噪音」。

part5.q: Please double-check the shipping address, ------- your order may be delayed.
part5.explanation: otherwise = 否則。「請再次確認寄送地址，否則訂單可能延誤」。

part5.q: The company's profits have increased ------- 15 percent compared with last year.
part5.explanation: increase by + 幅度 = 增加了…（幅度）。「獲利較去年成長 15%」。increase to 則是「增加到（某數值）」。

part5.q: Everyone attending the outdoor training session should dress ------- for hot weather.
part5.explanation: 修飾動詞 dress 用副詞 appropriately（合宜地）。「參加戶外訓練者應穿著適合炎熱天氣的服裝」。

part5.q: ------- demand for the limited-edition sneakers, the store imposed a limit of one pair per customer.
part5.explanation: 空格後是名詞片語，用介系詞片語 Owing to（由於）。「由於限量球鞋需求太高，每人限購一雙」。Because 要接子句。

part5.q: The intern quickly proved ------- capable of handling client inquiries independently.
part5.explanation: prove oneself capable of = 證明自己有能力…（反身代名詞）。「實習生很快證明自己能獨立處理客戶詢問」。

part5.q: Room rates at the resort ------- depending on the season.
part5.explanation: 主詞 rates 是複數，動詞用原形 vary。vary depending on = 依…而不同。「度假村房價依季節而異」。

part5.q: The legal team advised the company ------- the contract until all terms were clarified.
part5.explanation: advise + 受詞 + not to V = 建議某人不要做…。「法務團隊建議公司在條款釐清前不要簽約」。

part6.passage:
【E-mail】
From: Fleet Services
To: All Sales Representatives
Subject: Company Vehicle Inspections

Dear Sales Team,

This is a reminder that all company vehicles must undergo their annual safety inspection this month. Please schedule an [33] at the Maple Street service center by calling extension 4501. The inspection takes about ninety minutes, and loaner cars are available if you have client visits scheduled that day. Vehicles that miss the August deadline cannot be [34] for business travel until they pass inspection. After your inspection, submit the completed report to Fleet Services within three business days. Thank you for your [35] attention to this matter.

questions.explanation: schedule an appointment = 預約時間。車輛年度檢查需先預約，故選 (A)。
cannot be used = 不能被使用（被動語態）。「未通過檢查的車輛不得用於商務出行」。
修飾名詞 attention 用形容詞 prompt（迅速的），your prompt attention 為商業書信慣用語。

part6.passage:
【Announcement】
City of Fairview — Public Library Card Renewal

Starting September 1, Fairview Public Library cards will be valid for three years instead of two. Current cardholders do not need to take any action; existing cards will be [36] extended by one year. New residents can apply for a card at any branch by presenting a photo ID and proof of address, [37] a utility bill or rental agreement. In addition, the library is introducing a digital card that can be stored on your smartphone. The digital card gives you access to e-books, audiobooks, and online databases [38] you are. Visit www.fairviewlibrary.org to learn more.

questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 will be extended 用副詞 automatically（自動地）。「現有卡片將自動延長一年」。
such as = 例如，舉例說明 proof of address（水電帳單或租約）。
wherever you are = 無論你在哪裡。「數位借書證讓你隨時隨地使用電子書與資料庫」。

part7.passage:
【Instant messages】
Carla Mendes (2:04 P.M.)
Hi team — quick update. The client moved tomorrow's product demo from 10 A.M. to 9 A.M. Can everyone still make it?

Raj Patel (2:06 P.M.)
9 works for me. I'll get to the office by 8:15 to set up the demo laptop.

Yuki Tanaka (2:07 P.M.)
I have a dentist appointment at 8:30. I can cancel it if you need me there.

Carla Mendes (2:09 P.M.)
No need, Yuki. Raj and I can handle the demo. Could you just make sure the updated pricing sheet is in the shared folder before 8:45?

Yuki Tanaka (2:10 P.M.)
Already done — I uploaded it an hour ago. Version 3, with the new enterprise tier.

Carla Mendes (2:11 P.M.)
You're the best. Raj, let's meet in the demo room at 8:30 to run through everything once.

questions.q: What change does Ms. Mendes announce?
options: A meeting was moved to an earlier time.
questions.explanation: 客戶把產品展示從 10 點改到 9 點（moved from 10 A.M. to 9 A.M.），提前一小時，故選 (A)。

questions.q: At 2:10 P.M., what does Ms. Tanaka mean when she writes, "Already done"?
options: She has uploaded the pricing sheet.
She has finished the demo setup.
questions.explanation: Carla 請她在 8:45 前把報價表放到共用資料夾，她回 Already done — I uploaded it an hour ago，表示報價表已上傳，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What will Mr. Patel and Ms. Mendes do at 8:30 tomorrow?
questions.explanation: Carla 說 let's meet in the demo room at 8:30 to run through everything once（先排練一次），故選 (B)。

part7.passage:
【Report excerpt】
Northgate Mall — Customer Traffic Study (Executive Summary)
Prepared by Insight Retail Analytics, August 7

Over the past six months, we tracked visitor patterns at Northgate Mall to help management plan the upcoming renovation. Key findings are summarized below.

First, weekday traffic is heavily concentrated between 11:30 A.M. and 2:00 P.M., driven largely by office workers from the adjacent business park visiting the food court. Outside these hours, weekday traffic is 40 percent below the regional average for malls of similar size.

Second, weekend visitors stay longer (average 96 minutes versus 47 minutes on weekdays) and are far more likely to visit anchor department stores. However, 62 percent of weekend shoppers surveyed said the mall lacks family facilities, citing the absence of a play area and limited stroller access on the second floor.

We therefore recommend that the renovation prioritize: (1) expanding the food court seating area, (2) adding a children's play zone near the west entrance, and (3) installing a second elevator to improve second-floor access. Implementing these changes could increase overall weekly traffic by an estimated 12 to 18 percent.

options: To set new store rental fees
To choose a new mall location
questions.explanation: to help management plan the upcoming renovation，研究目的是協助規劃即將進行的改裝，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What is indicated about weekday lunchtime visitors?
options: They mostly come from a nearby business park.
They spend more than weekend visitors.
They shop mainly at department stores.
questions.explanation: driven largely by office workers from the adjacent business park visiting the food court，午間人潮主要是隔壁商業園區的上班族，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What did many weekend shoppers complain about?
questions.explanation: 62% 受訪者認為 the mall lacks family facilities（缺少親子設施），如遊戲區和嬰兒車通道，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What is NOT one of the report's recommendations?
questions.explanation: 三項建議是擴大美食街座位、增設兒童遊戲區、加裝第二部電梯；沒有建議開新百貨公司，故選 (D)。
